degradation_points.note: API Gateway throttling kicks in, Cognito rate limits hit

latency_drift.note: Moderate latency increase — likely OpenSearch index warming or DynamoDB adaptive capacity adjustments

bottlenecks.description: At 100+ concurrent VUs, Lambda cold starts add 1.5-2.5s latency. 48 functions sharing a single IAM role means VPC ENI attachment is serialized.
bottlenecks.impact: p99 latency spikes to 2.5s+ during traffic bursts

bottlenecks.description: AdminInitiateAuth has a default rate limit of ~25 RPS per user pool. Under stress, 429 throttling errors appear at 150+ VUs.

Nova Pro and Titan Embed have per-account TPS limits. Cross-region calls from ap-southeast-1 add 150-300ms base latency. At 30 concurrent WebSocket sessions, Bedrock throttling causes 6.8% error rate on analyzeGaps.
bottlenecks.impact: AI-powered features degrade under concurrent meeting load

bottlenecks.description: t3.small.search with 1 node is a single point of failure. Under concurrent vector search queries (knowledge base + skills), query latency increases 40% at 20+ concurrent searches.
bottlenecks.impact: Knowledge base search slows down during peak meeting activity

bottlenecks.description: The StrandsAgent handles ALL 11 WebSocket routes. analyzeGaps and endMeeting are compute-heavy (multiple Bedrock calls + DynamoDB reads + OpenSearch queries). At 30 concurrent connections, Lambda concurrency pressure causes timeouts.
bottlenecks.impact: Meeting summary generation and gap analysis fail under load

bottlenecks.description: Default API Gateway throttle is 10,000 RPS (account level) with 5,000 burst. Not a concern at current scale but becomes relevant at 500+ VUs.

recommendations.title: Enable Provisioned Concurrency for Critical Lambdas
recommendations.description: Set provisioned concurrency (5-10) on AdminLogin, CreateSession, AuthAuthorizer, and AdminAuthorizer to eliminate cold starts on the critical path.
recommendations.impact: Reduces p99 latency by 60-70% during spikes

recommendations.title: Request Bedrock Quota Increase
recommendations.description: Request increased TPS limits for Nova Pro and Titan Embed in us-east-1. Current defaults are insufficient for 15+ concurrent meetings.

recommendations.title: Scale OpenSearch to Multi-Node
recommendations.description: Upgrade from t3.small (1 node) to at least m6g.large (2 nodes) with dedicated master for production. Current setup is a single point of failure.

recommendations.title: Increase StrandsAgent Memory to 1024MB
recommendations.description: The 512MB allocation is tight for multi-tool agent invocations. Increasing to 1024MB also doubles CPU allocation, reducing Bedrock call orchestration time.

recommendations.title: Split StrandsAgent into Separate Handlers
recommendations.description: The single StrandsAgent Lambda handles all 11 WebSocket routes. Split processTranscript (high-frequency, low-latency) from analyzeGaps/endMeeting (low-frequency, high-compute) to isolate failure domains.

recommendations.title: Cache Cognito Token Validation in Authorizers
recommendations.description: Both authorizers have 0s cache TTL. Setting even a 60s cache would reduce Cognito calls by ~90% under normal traffic.
recommendations.impact: Reduces auth latency and Cognito rate limit pressure

recommendations.title: Consider DynamoDB Provisioned Capacity for Predictable Tables
recommendations.description: Users, Projects, and Agents tables have predictable access patterns. Switching to provisioned capacity with auto-scaling could reduce costs 50-70%.

recommendations.title: Add Custom CloudWatch Metrics for Load Testing
recommendations.description: Publish custom metrics for Bedrock call latency, OpenSearch query time, and warm pool dispatch latency to correlate with load test results.
recommendations.impact: Better root cause analysis during incidents
